title: Jewels of Japan | Tokyo to Osaka Discovery
highlights: Explore Japan's diverse landscapes, from Tokyo's modern vibe to the historical charm of Osaka, offering an experience of a lifetime.
Marvel at breathtaking views of Tokyo from 450 meters high on the Skytree's observation deck, a thrilling experience!
Admire the views of the highest peak in Japan, Mount Fuji, and the scenic Lake Ashi as you take the Hakone ropeway ride.
Experience the super-fast Shinkansen bullet train journey from Tokyo to Osaka, renowned globally for its speed.
Visit the Kinkakuji Temple and be struck by the serene beauty of its golden pavilion, set amidst a beautiful garden, offering a peaceful retreat.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Deluxe Hotel

know_before_you_go: Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Extra expenses like visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover are not a part of the package.
ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the tour/premises.
Pack appropriate clothing for Japan's distinct seasons and cultural sites.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
Familiarize yourself with Japan's cashless payment systems, like Suica and Pasmo cards.
Download essential travel apps, such as Google Translate and Jorudan.
Bring a portable charger for your devices, as power outlets may be scarce. Carry an adapter for Type A or Type B sockets.
Be prepared for crowds and lines at popular attractions and train stations.
Respect Japan's strict trash separation and recycling rules.
Stick to the tour schedule to fully enjoy all activities.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Upon arrival at the Narita International Airport, get transferred to your pre-booked hotel and begin your Japan adventure. Post check-in, you can relax for the day or explore Tokyo at your own pace by visiting the famous Honganji Temple, the Samurai Theater Tokyo, Shibuya Crossing, and more such attractions. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: This morning, head to Matsuya Ginza, the meeting point for your Tokyo sightseeing tour. Upon arrival, board the transfer to visit the Meiji Shrine, then travel through Ueno and Akihabara to the Imperial Palace. Continue to Asakusa to explore the surrounding temples, followed by a Matcha session and a traditional Japanese Izakaya lunch. Visit the Skytree observation deck before getting transferred to the drop-off point, Matsuya Ginza, from where you will reach the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From Matsuya Ginza with Lunch on a Shared basis

days.title: Excursion To Mount Fuji and Hakone
days.desc: In the morning, head to the Shinjuku Love meeting point from the hotel. As you arrive, board the transfer to begin your Mt. Fuji and Hakone tour. Visit the stunning Mount Fuji and its surroundings, followed by a Hakone ropeway ride. Later, explore Owakudani Valley, and get driven to the drop-off point, Odawara Station. From here, board a bullet train to Tokyo Station. Once you arrive, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight transfer.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka via Shinkansen Bullet Train
days.desc: Today, after check-out, head to the Tokyo Station on your own and board the Shinkansen bullet train to Osaka (tickets included). Upon arrival, reach your pre-booked hotel on your own and check-in. Enjoy the rest of the day exploring the city at your own pace and see places like the Sumiyoshi Taisha Shrine, the Osaka Science Museum, the Osaka Museum of Housing and Living, etc. After exploring the day at leisure, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Kyoto and Nara
days.desc: In the morning, reach the pick-up point, Hearton Hotel Nishiumeda, on your own to board your transfer for the excursion to Kyoto and Nara. Visit iconic landmarks like Kinkakuji Temple, Nara Park and Arashiyama District. After the excursion, get transferred to the drop-off point, Hearton Hotel Nishiumeda from where head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay in Osaka.

items.title: Kyoto and Nara Sightseeing Day Tour From Osaka - Osaka Departure on a Shared basis

days.title: Self-Explore the City- Osaka
days.desc: Enjoy a day exploring the city on your own wherein you can visit places like Osaka Castle and Tennoji Park in the morning. Attractions like Hozenji, Miraiza Osaka-Jo, and Ebisu Bridge in the afternoon. Later, end your day by visiting the Umeda district skyline, Umeda Sky Building, and Shinsekai. After a great self-exploration day, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Kansai International Airport. This is where your Japan tour comes to an end with memories of a lifetime.
